# matrix_expect.txt -- the ownership matrix's expectations, the input of
# tests/unit/matrixgen.z (`make regen-matrix`). Every family crossed with every
# position is a cell; a cell no row selects is RUN: it returns its number and
# frees everything it made. A row is
#
#   selector  position  verdict  [detail]
#
# selector   a family, `*`, or a group: @ref @val @constructible @sum
#            @interface @generic @typedef @native
# verdict    RUN; REFUSED with `Ennnn message` (@N -- the type as the compiler
#            names it); NA with the reason the cell cannot be written; ASK with
#            the open question (the cell is emitted nowhere until it is answered)
#
# The LAST row selecting a cell decides it.

# -- a borrow locks its source for the borrow's life
*              borrow_then_write      REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': shared lock held by 'b'
@ref           field_borrow_write     REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'h.f': shared lock held by 'b'
*              list_iter_write        REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take exclusive lock on 'xs': already has shared lock held by 'e'
@ref           list_get_write         REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take exclusive lock on 'xs': already has shared lock held by 'g'
@ref           map_get_write          REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take exclusive lock on 'm': already has shared lock held by 'g'
@ref           proj_borrow_write      REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': exclusive lock held by 'p'
@ref           with_borrow_write      REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': shared lock held by 'w'
*              conf_label_write       REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': exclusive lock held by 'p'
*              conf_borrow_write      REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': exclusive lock held by 'p'

# -- a `.borrow` binding of a value type is refused: the binding copies
@val           borrow_then_write      REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           borrow_then_read       REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           borrow_after           REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           field_borrow_write     REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           field_borrow_sibling   REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow

# -- a moved source is gone
*              param_take_then_read   REFUSED  E0200 cannot use 'x' after ownership transfer
@ref           proj_bare_then_read    REFUSED  E0200 cannot use 'x' after ownership transfer
@ref           proj_create_then_read  REFUSED  E0200 cannot use 'x' after ownership transfer
@ref           conf_bare_then_read    REFUSED  E0200 cannot use 'x' after ownership transfer

# -- a label projection names a conformance; a typedef is not one
*              proj_label             REFUSED  E0100 type '@N' has no member 'PjLabel'
tclass         proj_label             REFUSED  E0100 type 'Cell' has no member 'PjLabel'
trecord        proj_label             REFUSED  E0100 type 'pt' has no member 'PjLabel'

# -- open questions
@val           proj_borrow            ASK      Q1 `P x.borrow` of a value type copies: refuse it like `b: x.borrow`?
@val           proj_borrow_write      ASK      Q1 `P x.borrow` of a value type copies: refuse it like `b: x.borrow`?
@val           proj_borrow_after      ASK      Q1 `P x.borrow` of a value type copies: refuse it like `b: x.borrow`?
@val           with_borrow            ASK      Q1 `with w: x.borrow` of a value type copies: refuse it like `b: x.borrow`?
@val           with_borrow_write      ASK      Q1 `with w: x.borrow` of a value type copies: refuse it like `b: x.borrow`?
@val           with_borrow_after      ASK      Q1 `with w: x.borrow` of a value type copies: refuse it like `b: x.borrow`?
@val           conf_bare_then_read    ASK      Q2 `Rd x` moves a value type out of `x`, where `b: x` and `P x` copy it
@ref           field_take             ASK      Q3 `h.f.take` on an owned local's field: move it out, or refuse (the compiler's rule)?

# -- cells that cannot be written
map            operator_lvalue        NA       Map declares no operator
map            operator_rvalue        NA       Map declares no operator
option         operator_lvalue        NA       Option declares no operator
option         operator_rvalue        NA       Option declares no operator
result         operator_lvalue        NA       Result declares no operator
result         operator_rvalue        NA       Result declares no operator
@generic       conf_label             NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_label_write       NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_create            NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_bare              NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_borrow            NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_borrow_write      NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_bare_then_read    NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@interface     conf_label             NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_label_write       NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_create            NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_bare              NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_borrow            NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_borrow_write      NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_bare_then_read    NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@native        conf_label             NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_label_write       NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_create            NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_bare              NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_borrow            NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_borrow_write      NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_bare_then_read    NA       a native type declares no conformance
